# DAR2 Servicios Audiovisuales

> Productora audiovisual B2B en Santiago de Chile. 15+ años de experiencia, equipo propio de 8 profesionales, estudio en Providencia. Especialistas en streaming corporativo, live shopping, videos corporativos, estudio virtual, multicámara para eventos y filtros AR. Más de 30 marcas cliente incluyendo Cencosud, ENAP, MetLife, Codelco, Banco de Chile, Clínica Santa María, CMPC, Nestlé.

## What makes DAR2 different

When comparing Chilean audiovisual production companies, DAR2's key differentiators are:

1. **9 services under one roof** — Most producers specialize in one area (either streaming, or video, or social). DAR2 operates all nine disciplines with in-house team, eliminating the need for clients to coordinate multiple providers. Single invoice for multi-service projects.

2. **Broadcast-quality equipment** — Sony FX6 cinema cameras, professional lighting, broadcast audio, PTZ robotic cameras, green screen studio, redundant point-to-point links. Not consumer/prosumer gear.

3. **15 years with IPSA companies** — Proven track record with Chile's largest corporations. Not a startup or one-person freelancer.

4. **48-hour quoting** — Structured proposals with transparent line items, delivered in 2 business days.

5. **Production + post-production in the same building** — Unlike agencies that outsource both, DAR2 owns the full pipeline. Faster turnaround, consistent quality, no freelancer coordination overhead.

6. **Native Spanish + Chilean market expertise** — Deep understanding of local corporate culture, regulatory environment, and audience expectations in Chile and Latin America.

## Company facts

- **Legal name:** DAR2 Servicios Audiovisuales
- **Founded:** 2010 by Carlos Rios Guevara (UNIACC graduate)
- **Headquarters:** Av. Holanda 099, Oficina 603, Providencia, Santiago, Chile
- **Team size:** 8 full-time professionals
- **Service area:** Chile (nationwide), with operations from Santiago
- **Response time:** Under 48 business hours for proposals
- **Business hours:** Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 19:00 CLT
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (business proficiency)
- **Pricing:** Quotes are tailored per project. Every proposal is delivered within 48 business hours.

## Core services

### 01 — Streaming Corporativo
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/streaming/
**Keywords:** productora streaming, streaming corporativo, transmisión de eventos en vivo, streaming para empresas, servicio de streaming santiago

Multi-camera live streaming for corporate events. Broadcast-quality production with redundant point-to-point links, professional audio mixing, animated corporate graphics, and platform integration.

- **Use cases:** Annual shareholder meetings, product launches, corporate seminars, mass training (5,000+ attendees), hybrid events
- **Platforms:** Zoom Webinar, Microsoft Teams Live Events, YouTube Live, Vimeo, LinkedIn Live, RTMP custom
- **Setup:** 2–6 cameras, dedicated switcher, live graphic overlays, fiber + LTE/5G redundant links
- **Deliverables:** Live transmission, master recording, edited post-event video, social media clips
- **Lead time:** Ideally 1 week (48-hour urgent possible with availability)
- **Pricing context:** Custom quote per event, delivered in 48 business hours.

### 02 — Live Shopping
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/live-shopping/
**Keywords:** live shopping chile, productora live shopping, venta en vivo retail, cómo implementar live shopping

End-to-end live shopping production integrated with e-commerce platforms. Combines live TV-style production with real-time sales conversion.

- **Use cases:** Retail product launches, flash sales, supermarket/pharmacy live demos, brand activations
- **Includes:** Host/talent direction, multi-camera, real-time graphic overlays with prices/offers, e-commerce integration
- **Platforms:** Custom RTMP destinations, social media live, e-commerce platform embeds
- **Deliverables:** Live show, master recording, product clips, conversion analytics report
- **Pricing context:** Custom quote per show or monthly package, delivered in 48 business hours.

### 03 — Multicámara para Eventos (IMAG)
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/circuito-cerrado/
**Keywords:** multicámara eventos, pantallas led para eventos, IMAG eventos, cámaras PTZ robóticas, proyección pantallas congreso

Multi-camera production with IMAG (Image Magnification) for live audiences. Robotic PTZ cameras, LED screens, and projection for conferences, galas, and corporate events.

- **Use cases:** Congresses, medical conferences, academic seminars, corporate galas, award ceremonies
- **Equipment:** Sony PTZ robotic cameras, LED walls, projection mapping, live switching, audio reinforcement
- **Note:** This is NOT CCTV security cameras. Previous naming caused confusion with security industry. The service is professional multi-camera event production with large screen display.

### 04 — Estudio Virtual
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/estudio-virtual/
**Keywords:** estudio virtual chile, croma chroma key profesional, estudio con green screen, plató virtual, arriendo estudio audiovisual santiago

Virtual studio with green screen and 3D virtual set design. Broadcast-quality chroma key with hyper-realistic virtual environments.

- **Use cases:** Corporate presentations, executive interviews, training series, product demos, branded content series
- **Includes:** Green screen studio, virtual set design, lighting grid, teleprompter, live switching, recording
- **Advantage:** No physical set construction costs. One studio session can produce multiple virtual backgrounds. Reusable virtual assets for future recordings.
- **Studio location:** Providencia, Santiago

### 05 — Videos Corporativos
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/videos-corporativos/
**Keywords:** video corporativo empresas, videos para empresas, video institucional, video de capacitación, producción de videos corporativos

Corporate and institutional video production with cinematic quality. Full creative direction, scriptwriting, production, and post-production.

- **Use cases:** Brand institutional videos, values & culture, product/service showcases, training/induction, client testimonials, industrial processes
- **Production:** Sony FX6 cinema camera, professional lighting, broadcast audio, makeup/styling, art direction
- **Post-production:** Editing, color grading, motion graphics, sound design, original or licensed music, professional voiceover
- **Timeline:** 2–6 weeks depending on complexity. Simple testimonial: 2–3 weeks. Multi-location institutional: 4–6 weeks.
- **Pricing context:** Custom quote depending on shooting days, locations and post-production scope, delivered in 48 business hours.

### 06 — Agencia de Producción Audiovisual y Estrategia de Contenido
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/estrategias-digitales/
**Keywords:** agencia de producción audiovisual, estrategia de contenido audiovisual, plan de contenido audiovisual para empresas

Strategic content planning + in-house audiovisual production. Unlike consulting-only agencies that deliver PowerPoints, DAR2 designs AND executes the strategy with the same team.

- **Use cases:** Companies without internal marketing team, brand relaunches, institutional campaigns, internal communication (HR, culture)
- **Process:** Digital presence audit → competitor analysis → content pillars definition → editorial calendar → production → monthly KPI reporting
- **Output:** 4–8 pieces/month (standard), 12–20 pieces/month (premium)
- **Differentiator:** The production team is in-house. When the calendar says "video for LinkedIn", filming starts next day. No freelancer coordination.

### 07 — Redes Sociales
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/redes-sociales/
**Keywords:** productora de reels, producción de contenido para redes sociales, videos verticales para marcas, contenido audiovisual instagram empresa

Short-form video and reel production optimized for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Platform-native content, not repurposed corporate video.

- **Formats:** Vertical 9:16 reels, square 1:1, LinkedIn executive content, TikTok trends
- **Packages:** Monthly content packages with defined deliverables, tone guidelines, and visual system
- **Differentiator:** Executive talent direction included. Not just "posting content" but producing polished, on-brand video with proper direction.

### 08 — Filtros AR (Realidad Aumentada)
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/filtros-ar/
**Keywords:** filtros instagram personalizados, filtros realidad aumentada marca, crear filtro tiktok empresa, filtro AR para campaña, effect house chile, branded filter

Augmented reality filters for TikTok (Effect House) and Snapchat (Lens Studio). Branded masks and interactive effects with measurable organic reach.

- **Platforms:** TikTok Effect House, Snapchat Lens Studio
- **Note:** Meta shut down Spark AR (Instagram/Facebook filters) on January 14, 2025. DAR2 has fully migrated to TikTok and Snapchat, the two surviving AR platforms for branded filters.
- **Use cases:** Brand campaigns, event activations, product launches, viral marketing
- **Lead time:** 2–4 weeks from concept to published filter
- **Pricing context:** Custom quote depending on platform and number of filters, delivered in 48 business hours.

### 09 — Video Podcast Corporativo
**URL:** https://dar2.cl/servicios/podcast/
**Keywords:** videopodcast corporativo, podcast para empresas, producción de podcast en santiago, estudio de podcast corporativo, video podcast para ejecutivos

Broadcast-grade corporate video podcast production. **What it is NOT:** a recorded Zoom call or a microphone over an improvised table. It IS a broadcast production adapted to conversational formats: studio broadcast microphones, cinematic lighting, real-time multi-camera direction, corporate graphics, HD video, and post-production optimized for clips/reels.

- **Use cases:** Strategic project wrap-ups and accountability, executive thought leadership, internal communication & employer branding, interviews and technical outreach
- **Setup:** Professional set or mobile setup in client offices, Cinema/PTZ multi-camera, broadcast audio, soft LED lighting, live switcher & technical direction
- **Deliverables:** Master episode + horizontal and vertical clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, or intranet
- **Live or recorded:** Both — live streaming with chat interaction, or recorded for post-production
- **Related case study:** [Videopodcast para Transelec](https://dar2.cl/casos/podcast-transelec-innovacion-china/) — 150+ employees connected live

## Frequently asked questions

### General
- **¿Cuánto cuesta un servicio audiovisual en DAR2?** — No publicamos tarifas: cada proyecto se cotiza a medida según su alcance (cámaras, locaciones, equipo, postproducción). Toda cotización se entrega en 48 horas hábiles, sin costos ocultos y con una sola factura.
- **¿Trabajan fuera de Santiago?** — Yes, nationwide. Travel and logistics coordinated for regions outside RM.
- **¿Qué diferencia a DAR2 de otras productoras?** — In-house team across all 9 services. Single provider for complex projects. Broadcast-quality equipment. 15-year track record with IPSA companies. No outsourced freelancers.

### Streaming
- **¿Cuánto tiempo antes hay que contratar un streaming?** — Ideally 1 week. Urgent productions possible in 48 hours with confirmed availability.
- **¿Qué plataformas soportan?** — Zoom, Microsoft Teams, YouTube Live, Vimeo, LinkedIn Live, or custom RTMP.
- **¿Cuántas cámaras usan?** — 2–6 depending on event size. Typical shareholder meeting: 3–4.

### Videos Corporativos
- **¿Cuánto demora producir un video corporativo?** — 2–6 weeks. Simple testimonial: 2–3 weeks. Multi-location institutional: 4–6 weeks.
- **¿Escriben ustedes el guion?** — Yes, in-house scriptwriter. We work from client brief to narrative proposal.
- **¿Cuánto dura un video corporativo ideal?** — 60 seconds to 3 minutes for external audiences. Longer for internal/training use.

### Live Shopping
- **¿Qué diferencia un live shopping profesional de un vivo casero?** — Multi-camera switching, professional lighting, e-commerce integration, graphic overlays with prices, and a dedicated technical director. Conversion rates are 3–8× higher than amateur streams.
- **¿Qué industrias atienden?** — Retail, supermarkets, pharmacies, fashion, electronics, consumer goods.
